answer.narrative: Recommendation: call reserve Captain C-3310 (₹18,500). BLR-based, A320-rated, on-call window covers the 06:00Z report, clears all seven rules, and takes the full 2-day pairing so day 2 out of DEL is not orphaned. If C-3310 is unreachable, C-1526 on a day-off callout is the clean fallback at ₹24,000. Deadheading C-2210 from DEL (₹41,200, DX412 ~3h late) only makes sense if no BLR captain is available — and even then it beats the ₹250,000-per-leg cancellation cost.

narration: Recommendation: call reserve Captain C-3310 at ₹18,500 — clean on all seven rules and covers the full 2-day pairing.
